<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Lists the recent trades of each market, one item per trade, with its value in dollars: for spotting large buyers and sellers.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.trades` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Look back (`since`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `1h` | How far back, e.g. 15m or 1h. |
| Limit (`limit`) | whole number | no | `50` | Most trades per market, up to 500. |
